rationale: 62/309 contains 'ḥatta d qodanno mtarasna aʕmux', matching mtarasn-a aʕmux after clitic-boundary normalization. The king requests time to prepare his daughter's dowry and send her with the young man. 62/301 instead records the witnesses' testimony and contains no such phrase. The automatic candidate 62/94 is a different example and is not the correction.
Glücksgüter is plural, requiring viele here. This also agrees with the edition's 'nie viele Glücksgaben'; the proposed correction preserves the glossary's own noun.
